course.title: Unit 2 Ways to go to school-Part B--【例句】

sentences.content: Mr Jones, how can I get to the Fuxing Hospital?
sentences.english: Mr Jones , how can I get to the Fuxing Hospital ?
sentences.chinese: Jones先生，请问去Fuxing Hospital怎么走？

sentences.content: Take the No. 57 bus over there.
sentences.english: Take the No . 57 bus over there

sentences.content: Thanks. Wow!
sentences.english: Thanks . Wow !

sentences.content: So many pictures of bikes!
sentences.english: So many pictures of bikes !

sentences.content: They’re from my cousin in the USA.
sentences.english: They're from my cousin in the USA
sentences.chinese: 它们来自我在美国的表亲。

sentences.content: What’s this?
sentences.english: What's this ?

sentences.content: A helmet. In the USA people on bikes must wear one.
sentences.english: A helmet . In the USA people on bikes must wear one
sentences.chinese: 头盔。在美国，骑自行车的人必须佩戴。

sentences.content: I see. Oh, the bus is coming!
sentences.english: I see . Oh , the bus is coming !

sentences.content: Bye, Mr Jones.
sentences.english: Bye , Mr Jones

sentences.content: Hey, don’t go at the red light!
sentences.english: Hey , don't go at the red light !

sentences.content: Oh, right! Thanks.
sentences.english: Oh , right ! Thanks

sentences.content: I must pay attention to the traffic lights!
sentences.english: I must pay attention to the traffic lights !
sentences.chinese: 我必须注意交通信号灯！

sentences.content: You must stop.
sentences.english: You must stop

sentences.content: You can see this on the road.
sentences.english: You can see this on the road
sentences.chinese: 你可以在路上看到这个。

sentences.content: Don’t touch the door.
sentences.english: Don't touch the door

sentences.content: You can see this in the subway.
sentences.english: You can see this in the subway
sentences.chinese: 你可以在地铁里看到这个。

sentences.content: Slow down and stop at a yellow light.
sentences.english: Slow down and stop at a yellow light

sentences.content: Stop and wait at a red light.
sentences.english: Stop and wait at a red light

sentences.content: Go at a green light.
sentences.english: Go at a green light

sentences.content: Look! The park is over there! Let’s go!
sentences.english: Look ! The park is over there ! Let's go !
sentences.chinese: 看！公园就在那边！我们走吧！

sentences.content: Please wait! It’s red now.
sentences.english: Please wait ! It's red now

sentences.content: We must stop and wait.
sentences.english: We must stop and wait

sentences.content: Slow down and stop!
sentences.english: Slow down and stop !

sentences.content: Stop and wait!
sentences.english: Stop and wait !

sentences.content: Let’s go!
sentences.english: Let's go !

sentences.content: How many ways can you think of to go to school?
sentences.english: How many ways can you think of to go to school ?
sentences.chinese: 你能想到多少种去学校的方式？

sentences.content: Talk with your partner.
sentences.english: Talk with your partner

sentences.content: Some children go to school on foot in Munich, Germany.
sentences.english: Some children go to school on foot in Munich , Germany
sentences.chinese: 在德国Munich，一些孩子步行上学。

sentences.content: Some children in Jiangxi, China, go to school by ferry every day.
sentences.english: Some children in Jiangxi , China , go to school by ferry every day
sentences.chinese: 中国江西的一些孩子每天乘渡船上学。

sentences.content: Grandpa, let me read this for you.
sentences.english: Grandpa , let me read this for you
sentences.chinese: 爷爷，让我来为您读这个吧。

sentences.content: In Alaska, USA, it snows a lot.
sentences.english: In Alaska , USA , it snows a lot
sentences.chinese: 在美国的阿拉斯加，经常下雪。

sentences.content: Some kids go to school by sled.
sentences.english: Some kids go to school by sled
sentences.chinese: 有些孩子乘坐雪橇去上学。

sentences.content: It’s fast.
sentences.english: It's fast

sentences.content: In Papa Westray, Scotland, the children go to school by ferry, too.
sentences.english: In Papa Westray , Scotland , the children go to school by ferry , too
sentences.chinese: 在苏格兰的Papa Westray，孩子们也乘渡轮上学。

sentences.content: But in 2009, they went to school by plane because the ferry didn’t work.
sentences.english: But in 2009 , they went to school by plane because the ferry didn't work
sentences.chinese: 但在2009年，他们乘飞机去上学，因为渡轮无法运行。

sentences.content: Thanks, Robin.
sentences.english: Thanks , Robin

sentences.content: I don’t go to school.
sentences.english: I don't go to school

sentences.content: I learn at home.
sentences.english: I learn at home

sentences.content: How many ways to go to school can you find in the text?
sentences.english: How many ways to go to school can you find in the text ?
sentences.chinese: 你能在文中找到多少种上学的方式？

sentences.content: Underline them.
sentences.english: Underline them

sentences.content: Does everyone in the text go to school?
sentences.english: Does everyone in the text go to school ?
sentences.chinese: 文本中的每个人都去上学吗？
